about_the_game:
There are several different game modes in this Tower Defense Strategy (TD), which can be completed in one go or with endless enemies - resist countless waves of enemies for as long as possible and complete missions!

Complete the storyline to earn rich rewards, and challenge stronger enemies to earn more rewards.

-Simple, optimized, small in size but fully functional.

-Having dozens of different levels and a large number of tasks - no endless hard work!

-A huge permanent upgrade tree (over 500 different studies).

-Completing hardcore tasks can lead to many achievements

-Detailed statistical data for each run

-Complete the storyline and unlock stronger challenge tasks

-No ads, everything can be unlocked for free!
